queries.sql: SELECT h.*, (SELECT image_url FROM hotel_images WHERE hotel_id = h.id AND is_primary = TRUE LIMIT 1) AS primary_image FROM hotels h WHERE h.is_featured = TRUE AND h.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY h.rating DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT id, name, region FROM cities WHERE is_active=TRUE ORDER BY name ASC

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.region, COUNT(h.id) AS hotel_count FROM cities c JOIN hotels h ON LOWER(h.city) = LOWER(c.name) AND h.is_active=TRUE WHERE c.is_active=TRUE GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.region ORDER BY hotel_count DESC, c.name ASC

SELECT h.*, COUNT(b.id) AS booking_count, (SELECT image_url FROM hotel_images WHERE hotel_id=h.id AND is_primary=TRUE LIMIT 1) AS primary_image FROM hotels h LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.hotel_id=h.id AND b.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE h.is_active = TRUE GROUP BY h.id ORDER BY booking_count DESC, h.rating DESC LIMIT 4
